title: je-dict-1 Pipeline Configuration
description: Defines a queue of dictionary maintenance tasks for automated or semi-automated execution.

description.description: Human-readable description of this pipeline run.

branch.description: Default git branch for commits. Individual tasks can override this.

on_failure.description: Default behavior when a task fails validation. 'stop' halts the pipeline, 'skip' moves to the next task.

tasks.description: Ordered list of tasks to execute.

type.description: The task type, which maps to a prompt file in prompts/.

count.description: Number of times to invoke this task (each invocation is one Claude session).

branch.description: Git branch for this task's commits. Overrides the top-level branch.

on_failure.description: Behavior when this task fails validation. Overrides the top-level on_failure.

parameters.description: Optional task-specific parameters passed to the prompt.

batch_size.description: Number of entries to process per invocation.

tier.description: Restrict processing to entries in this vocabulary tier.

pos.description: Restrict processing to entries with this part of speech (e.g., "verb", "noun").
